subject: Post-call confirmation: volume slab & peak TPS for hosted pricing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Martinez <sarah.martinez@brightbridgehealth.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & ask — volume bands, peak TPS, budget target

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the items we need to lock down so I can get a formal pricing proposal over to you: 

What I captured from the call (please correct if I missed anything):
- Primary use: conversational triage + summarization for patient intake forms.
- Typical request payload: ~1.2–1.8k tokens (prompt + user context).
- Expected baseline: ~5–8M tokens/month in the first 3 months, with growth to ~10–15M by Q4.
- Peak behavior: steady daytime concurrency around 10–15 TPS; end-of-month reconciliation spikes up to ~45–60 TPS for 20–30 minutes.
- Latency target: p95 generation < 800ms.
- Compliance: SOC 2 and audit logs required (we discussed Private vs Hosted controls).

As next steps I need three confirmation points from you so we can produce an accurate hosted pricing quote (and a committed discount tier):
1) A monthly token range you’re comfortable committing to for a 6–12 month term (e.g., 5–10M, 10–20M).
2) Typical average request size (tokens) and the frequency of end-of-month bursts (how often per quarter).
3) Target unit economics — what is your target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range for this workload? A ballpark helps us map to discount bands.

I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines deliverables and timelines; if you can review and confirm the numbers above, I’ll turn around pricing scenarios (hosted on-demand, 6/12-month committed, and a burstable SLA note) by tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priYom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sarah Martinez <sarah.martinez@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask — volume bands, peak TPS, budget target

Thanks Priyom — good summary. Quick answers below (Alex and I both included).

Confirmed details / clarifications:
- Average request size: ~1.5k tokens (we include a short patient history + form + system instruction).
- Baseline monthly volume: right now we’re planning conservative rollout at ~6M tokens/mo, with expected growth to ~12M/mo within 6 months if pilot metrics look good.
- Bursts: end-of-month billing/reconciliation drives short spikes. Expect 2–3 spikes per month, typically 20–40 minutes long; peak observed 55–60 TPS in our tests.
- Budget: we don’t have final procurement approved yet, but target budget for hosted inference is $6k–$10k/month while we validate value. For committed pricing we’d be looking for a target of roughly $700–$900 per 1M tokens (ballpark).
- Compliance: we’ll need standard SOC 2 evidence and simple retention controls; we’ll flag anything else via the questionnaire.

We’re happy to proceed with the MAP — Alex, can you confirm the internal procurement timeline?

Thanks,
Sarah Martinez
Director, Product Ops
BrightBridge Health
sarah.martinez@brightbridgehealth.com

- Baseline 6M/mo -> growth to ~12M/mo in ~6 months.
- Avg request size ~1.5k tokens.
- Peak spikes up to ~55–60 TPS for short windows (2–3x per month).

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Thanks for the clear notes. Attached is a short PDF with three hosted pricing scenarios and the MAP with milestones: pricing-scenarios.pdf (attached). High-level summary here to keep things short: 

Scenario A — On-demand (no commit)- Estimated cost @ 6M tokens/mo: $9,000/mo (~$1,500 per 1M tokens)- Pros: no upfront; flexible- Cons: higher unit cost for predictable usage

Scenario B — Committed (6 or 12 mo)- 6 mo / 5M commit: $1,200 per 1M tokens (effective) -> expected monthly on 6M: $7,200- 12 mo / 10M commit: $960 per 1M tokens (20% off list) -> expected monthly on 12M: $11,520- 24 mo / 20M commit: $700 per 1M tokens (volume band) -> expected monthly on 20M: $14,000

Scenario C — Commitment + burstable SLA add-on- Includes short-duration burst capacity to 80 TPS for 30 minutes with a small uplift (applies to committed tiers).- Add-on cost: $1,000/mo on top of committed rate for the 5–10M tiers; waived for 20M+ bands.

Notes:
- We can do a temporary pilot credit to help validate value before a commit.
- SOC 2 evidence and audit log access are available for hosted customers; if you require VPC/on-prem we can discuss a Private deployment but that’s typically a longer procurement path.

Next steps:
1) If the committed 12-month 10M scenario looks like your target, please sign the MAP (DocuSign link below) so we can lock pricing and schedule onboarding.
2) If you want a blended quote hit target $/1M ~ $700–$900, we can propose a 9–12 month ramp with an initial credit to match your $6k–$10k pilot budget.

DocuSign MAP: https://docusign.com/rb/4521/mutual-action-plan
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4521
